# investigate a list of new(ish) command line tools

Go through Julia Evans' [list of new(ish) command-line tools](https://jvns.ca/blog/2022/04/12/a-list-of-new-ish--command-line-tools/) (ripgrep, fd, fzf, bat, exa/eza, delta, zoxide, hyperfine, jq successors, and so on) and pick candidates for the toolset.
